comment: Hardware needs: the one table of names, bits and the parts that satisfy them.
xiaotai/needs.h (XIAOTAI_NEED_<NAME>), the derivation in src/hal.cc and the build's
check of board.json (scripts/sdk_selection.py) all follow this file; a test compares them.
A need is satisfied when the board has at least one part of the class whose fields match
every entry of 'where' (a field absent from board.json takes the value in 'defaults').
Bits never change once given; a new need is appended with the next bit.
A 'role' entry of 'where' names a role family: it matches the role itself and any role
that continues with '.' ('door' matches 'door' and 'door.gate', not 'doorbell').
'vocabulary' maps the board.json spellings to the C enumerators of xiaotai/hal.h (audio encodings:
the codec values of xiaotai/codec.h that hal.h takes). A spelling is the enumerator without its
prefix, in lower case; theme manifests use the same spellings for display.pixel.
Parts that are removable (none in this version) satisfy no need.
requested_comment: Needs waiting for their bit in xiaotai/needs.h (none now). An entry moves into 'needs' (and hal.cc derives it) together with the bit; until then nothing reads this list. door_lock is a relay in the role family the lock module claims, so that a board whose only relay is not a door lock fails the lock module's check. Network kinds and measurements derive no need: the driver of a network kind is found by the manifests that provide it, and a measurement is read when present.
